## PR Description

Fixes #1554

Every surface that pins a model endpoint — `roles:` chain entries and `customProviders:` entries (plus the gh-1398 `models.custom` surface) — can carry `connectTimeoutMs`/`streamIdleTimeoutMs`; per FIELD the first level that declares a value wins:

```
role chain entry > customProviders entry > models.custom entry
    > global providerTimeouts: > built-in default (connect 180s, idle 300s)
```

## Delivered (AC checklist)

- [x] **AC1** — roles chain entry timeouts ride the built `Model` (`connectTimeout`/`streamIdleTimeout` + `timeoutScopeLabel` = `role <role> override`) — request-scoped, so they drive the watchdogs for THAT role's streams only, work for catalog-default baseUrls (never URL-seedable before), and two entries on one endpoint keep separate windows. UT: resolver builds labeled models per role, per-field absence stays null. IT (loopback): scoped 1s window fires for its model while a second model in the same session takes the 3s global window; stall line names `idle window 1s (role slow override)`, the unscoped model's does not.
- [x] **AC2** — `customProviders:` entry timeouts scope every resolution through the entry: main provider + roles refs naming its kind+baseUrl resolve through the URL-keyed table (boot seeding, both CLI and app — `bin/fah.dart` IS the CLI boot, `fah_runapp.dart` is its part file).
- [x] **AC3** — the full precedence table per field: `ProviderTuningRegistry.matchesForUrl` returns matching entries in priority order (depth desc, later registration first); `resolveProviderTimeouts` + both wire helpers walk the chain per field, so an entry overriding only the idle leg falls through to the lower surface's connect leg instead of jumping to global. Seed order fixed to `models.custom < customProviders < roleRefs < queue` (the old order inverted customProviders vs models.custom). UTs: mixed-field fall-through, same-field collision, global/default reach, wire-helper agreement, seed-order table.
- [x] **AC4** — backward compat: all new fields nullable; every untouched config resolves byte-identically (empty registry fast paths intact; stall messages unchanged when no scope is in effect; gh-1398 parser suites untouched and still pin valid/absent/malformed/0/negative/over-1h on all four surfaces). The connect stall trace now reports the EFFECTIVE budget (was the raw global default even when a table entry resolved lower — latent gh-1398 inconsistency, fixed in passing).
- [x] **AC5** — docs: new "Scoped provider timeouts" section in `docs/agents/providers.md` (precedence table + slow-local-model recipe) and the `self-settings` skill (`prompts/skills/self-settings/SKILL.md` keys + paragraph; `prompts.g.dart` synced — see gate note).

Design pt 4: stall error lines and `[net]` replay lines keep their shape; a scoped override appends the naming fragment (`— idle window 1800s (role smol override)` / `(<source>)` before the pinned watchdog tags — contains-matching classifiers unaffected).

## Remaining

- Nothing known against the ACs. Non-goals respected: no auto-detection, no escalation-ladder changes, no per-model surface beyond `models:`.

## Verification / local-gate disclosure (honest)

- Targeted local gate attempted once per lane discipline: `dart test` on the three touched test files — **SIGKILLed (exit 137, machine guard), zero output** (the prompts regen script was killed the same way). **Static fallback** used instead: no new Dart files (all edits in existing files, directive order untouched); every referenced symbol verified defined/imported (barrel whole-file exports audited); ast-grep/tree-sitter parse of all 10 changed Dart files reported no parse issues; every changed call site audited (all pre-existing callers positional — additive named params only); 1:1 assertion trace against the implementation caught and fixed 2 wrong assertions in my own new tests before push. `prompts.g.dart` was hand-synced to `scripts/gen_prompts.dart`'s exact escaping (\`dartStringLiteral\`: `'`→`\'`, `$`, `\n`, `\r`, `\t`, non-ASCII raw) — `test/prompts/prompts_sync_test.dart` is the byte-level arbiter in CI.
- The PR's CI is the real gate; no fake test output.

+## Scoped provider timeouts (issue #1554)
+
+`connectTimeoutMs`/`streamIdleTimeoutMs` (strict positive ints, ≤ 1 h) are

+`customProviders:` entries, and `models.custom:` entries. Per FIELD, the
+first level that declares a value wins:
+
+```
+role chain entry > customProviders entry > models.custom entry
+    > global providerTimeouts: > built-in default (connect 180 s, idle 300 s)
+```
+

+connect leg at the lower levels. Configs without the keys behave
+byte-identically (the standing uncapped-run rule). When a scoped override is
+in effect the stall line names it (`idle window 1800s (role default
+override)`), so a wide window never reads as a hang.
+
+Slow-local-model recipe: a local endpoint that thinks minutes before the
+first byte needs the IDLE leg widened, not the whole config. On the role
+chain entry pinning the local endpoint set only `streamIdleTimeoutMs ≈ 2×`
+its worst silent prefill stretch — every cloud provider in the same config
+keeps the global watchdog untouched.

+      streamIdleTimeoutMs: 1800000   # this entry only

# SM kicker — thin stub over the canonical watchdog in the factory home.
# All logic (sm-liveness + head-completeness) lives in
# IstiN/dmtools-agentic-workflows/.github/workflows/factory-sm-kicker.yml;
# defaults below match this repo (ci.yml, three required contexts).
name: SM kicker

run-name: '🥁 kicker ${{ github.event_name }} ${{ github.ref_name }}'

on:
  push:
    branches-ignore: [main]
  schedule:
    - cron: '13,43 * * * *'
  # Event-driven wake-up (2026-10-03, parity with dmtools-dart#338):
  # GitHub starved both crons (machine-sm */10 + kicker 13,43) for 100
  # minutes on dmtools-dart; a green validation verdict sat unlatched the
  # whole window. CI conclusions are the verdict moments — react to them
  # and latching/FIFO-arming happen within seconds, cron or no cron.
  workflow_run:
    workflows: [CI]
    types: [completed]
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  actions: write
  contents: read
  pull-requests: read
  checks: read

jobs:
  kicker:
    # Tracks dmtools-agentic-workflows @main — always-latest policy (owner
    # directive 2026-10-04): kicker fixes (real ticks awf#13, per-head-SHA
    # concurrency awf#14) go live on merge, no re-pin ceremony; the
    # concurrency scoping lives in the reusable workflow. Guarded by
    # test/machine_kit/factory_stub_ref_test.dart.
    #
    # KNOWN UPSTREAM DEFECT (awf#15, live on awf@main as of 2026-10-04):
    # the head-completeness job's `gh api` calls put `--jq` BEFORE
    # `--arg`/`--argjson`, so gh eats the flag as the --jq value and the
    # rest become positional args — `accepts 1 arg(s), received 4`, exit 1.
    # Trigger shape: a CODELESS branch head (2 parents, 0 changed files —
    # a routine branch-sync merge with no content diff). Code-bearing
    # heads skip before the broken lines, so only zero-diff merge heads
    # crash the job — and they crash it even when CI is fully green (the
    # crash precedes the required-contexts check), so the job's own
    # rescue dispatch can never heal the exact heads it exists for.
    # Resolution until the upstream fix lands: keep the branch head
    # CODE-BEARING — the next real commit re-enables the healthy
    # code-bearing-head skip. Diagnosed 2026-10-04 on run 37193754301
    # (head 1fe9b1232, a zero-diff sync merge).
    uses: IstiN/dmtools-agentic-workflows/.github/workflows/factory-sm-kicker.yml@main
    with:
      sm_workflow: machine-sm.yml
      ci_workflow: ci.yml
      ci_display_name: CI
      required_contexts: 'Quality gate,JS engine integration (quickjs-ng),Binaries smoke gate'

# AGENTS.md

Conventions for AI agents and contributors in this repository. Keep it
factual: paths, commands, invariants — no essays.

## Project layout

- `lib/` — the `flutter_agent_harness` package (pure Dart core). `test/`
  mirrors it. `prompts/` — all LLM prompts as Markdown (see rules below).
- `lib/flutter_agent_harness.dart` (the barrel) — gh-1232 policy:
  GROUPED APPEND-ONLY export sections, one `// ── <subsystem> ──` comment
  header per group, exports sorted by path within a group, new exports
  appended to their subsystem group (a new subsystem starts a new group).
  No per-subsystem mini-barrels, no re-sorting of existing lines — append
  only, so parallel edits almost never touch the same line.
- God-file ceiling (gh-1232): no Dart file over 2800 lines anywhere
  (crap4dart `loc` gate, `max_lines: 2800` — issue #1234 migrated the
  shell guards; enforced whole-tree in CI and on staged files by the
  pre-commit hook. Scope: core `lib bin` via `crap4dart.yaml` +
  `test example` via the `crap4dart.loc-scope.yaml` companion config
  (0.11.0 has no per-gate sources override), flutter_app/lib via
  `flutter_app/crap4dart.yaml`).
  Target < 2000 for primary
  files; when a file approaches it, split by concern into `part` files
  (the established pattern: `agent_cli.dart`, `builtin_tools.dart`,
  `bin/fah.dart` → `bin/fah_*.dart`, `agent_service.dart` →
  `agent_service_*.dart` mixins) — never by extracting public API.
- `lib/src/approval/` — tool approval gate: tiers (read/write/exec),
  session modes (always-ask/write/yolo/autopilot — the CLI label of the
  `unattended` enum), per-tool overrides,
  critical-pattern
  `bash` interceptor, per-turn grants (`grantForTurn(allow:, deny:)` —
  skill `allowed-tools`/`disallowed-tools` manifest keys ride these for one
  turn; explicit deny > turnDeny > per-tool override > turnAllow >
  alwaysAllow > mode (critical bash outranks mode in always-ask/write/yolo,
  but is skipped in unattended so the mode never blocks — for runs with no
  user present); `clearTurnGrants()`
  on every new user
  message). Wired via `attachApproval` into `beforeToolCall` (runs
  first); prompt UI is an injectable `ApprovalPrompt` (null + prompt policy
  = deny).
- `lib/src/tools/ask_tool.dart` — `ask` tool: structured mid-turn questions
  via injectable `AskCallback` (null = error, cancel = plain result).
- `lib/src/tools/request_secret_tool.dart` — `request_secret` tool: the agent
  asks the USER for a missing credential via injectable
  `RequestSecretCallback` (never in chat text); a grant returns
  `RequestSecretResult` (host-adjusted `name`, `value`, `persisted` flag),
  a decline is a plain result. The app wires it in `AgentService` to
  `secretRequestHandler` (chat screen installs
  `ui/widgets/secret_request_sheet.dart`): a grant is persisted into
  `SessionKeysStore`, injected into the live shell env via
  `SecretsExecutionEnv.addSecrets` (the map is runtime-mutable now), and
  registered into the same `SecretRedactor` — so the next run's prompt name
  list, bash `$NAME`, and redaction all pick it up.
- `lib/src/env/session_vars_execution_env.dart` — `SessionVarsExecutionEnv`:
  an `ExecutionEnv` decorator injecting session-correlation env vars
  (`FAH_SESSION_ID`/`FAH_SESSION_FILE`/`FAH_PROVIDER`/`FAH_MODEL`, resolved
  live per `exec`, never secrets) into bash tool executions. Wired around
  `builtinTools` in the CLI (`AgentCli`) and the app (`AgentService`).
  `LocalShell` merges `ShellExecOptions.env` OVER `Platform.environment`

# Pull Request Information

- **PR #**: 1567
- **URL**: https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/pull/1567
- **Title**: feat(1554): scoped provider timeouts — roles chain entries + customProviders entries override the globals
- **Author**: vabhzw17eg2qu4m9-bit
- **Branch**: `feat/1554-scoped-provider-timeouts` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 17
- **Additions**: +638
- **Deletions**: -74
- **Created**: 2026-10-12T10:58:28Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-12T12:28:15Z

## PR Description

Fixes #1554

Every surface that pins a model endpoint — `roles:` chain entries and `customProviders:` entries (plus the gh-1398 `models.custom` surface) — can carry `connectTimeoutMs`/`streamIdleTimeoutMs`; per FIELD the first level that declares a value wins:

```
role chain entry > customProviders entry > models.custom entry
    > global providerTimeouts: > built-in default (connect 180s, idle 300s)
```

## Delivered (AC checklist)

- [x] **AC1** — roles chain entry timeouts ride the built `Model` (`connectTimeout`/`streamIdleTimeout` + `timeoutScopeLabel` = `role <role> override`) — request-scoped, so they drive the watchdogs for THAT role's streams only, work for catalog-default baseUrls (never URL-seedable before), and two entries on one endpoint keep separate windows. UT: resolver builds labeled models per role, per-field absence stays null. IT (loopback): scoped 1s window fires for its model while a second model in the same session takes the 3s global window; stall line names `idle window 1s (role slow override)`, the unscoped model's does not.
- [x] **AC2** — `customProviders:` entry timeouts scope every resolution through the entry: main provider + roles refs naming its kind+baseUrl resolve through the URL-keyed table (boot seeding, both CLI and app — `bin/fah.dart` IS the CLI boot, `fah_runapp.dart` is its part file).
- [x] **AC3** — the full precedence table per field: `ProviderTuningRegistry.matchesForUrl` returns matching entries in priority order (depth desc, later registration first); `resolveProviderTimeouts` + both wire helpers walk the chain per field, so an entry overriding only the idle leg falls through to the lower surface's connect leg instead of jumping to global. Seed order fixed to `models.custom < customProviders < roleRefs < queue` (the old order inverted customProviders vs models.custom). UTs: mixed-field fall-through, same-field collision, global/default reach, wire-helper agreement, seed-order table.
- [x] **AC4** — backward compat: all new fields nullable; every untouched config resolves byte-identically (empty registry fast paths intact; stall messages unchanged when no scope is in effect; gh-1398 parser suites untouched and still pin valid/absent/malformed/0/negative/over-1h on all four surfaces). The connect stall trace now reports the EFFECTIVE budget (was the raw global default even when a table entry resolved lower — latent gh-1398 inconsistency, fixed in passing).
- [x] **AC5** — docs: new "Scoped provider timeouts" section in `docs/agents/providers.md` (precedence table + slow-local-model recipe) and the `self-settings` skill (`prompts/skills/self-settings/SKILL.md` keys + paragraph; `prompts.g.dart` synced — see gate note).

Design pt 4: stall error lines and `[net]` replay lines keep their shape; a scoped override appends the naming fragment (`— idle window 1800s (role smol override)` / `(<source>)` before the pinned watchdog tags — contains-matching classifiers unaffected).

## Remaining

- Nothing known against the ACs. Non-goals respected: no auto-detection, no escalation-ladder changes, no per-model surface beyond `models:`.

## Verification / local-gate disclosure (honest)

- Targeted local gate attempted once per lane discipline: `dart test` on the three touched test files — **SIGKILLed (exit 137, machine guard), zero output** (the prompts regen script was killed the same way). **Static fallback** used instead: no new Dart files (all edits in existing files, directive order untouched); every referenced symbol verified defined/imported (barrel whole-file exports audited); ast-grep/tree-sitter parse of all 10 changed Dart files reported no parse issues; every changed call site audited (all pre-existing callers positional — additive named params only); 1:1 assertion trace against the implementation caught and fixed 2 wrong assertions in my own new tests before push. `prompts.g.dart` was hand-synced to `scripts/gen_prompts.dart`'s exact escaping (\`dartStringLiteral\`: `'`→`\'`, `$`, `\n`, `\r`, `\t`, non-ASCII raw) — `test/prompts/prompts_sync_test.dart` is the byte-level arbiter in CI.
- The PR's CI is the real gate; no fake test output.

+## Scoped provider timeouts (issue #1554)
+
+`connectTimeoutMs`/`streamIdleTimeoutMs` (strict positive ints, ≤ 1 h) are
+valid on three config surfaces: `roles:` chain entries (map form),
+`customProviders:` entries, and `models.custom:` entries. Per FIELD, the
+first level that declares a value wins:
+
+```
+role chain entry > customProviders entry > models.custom entry
+    > global providerTimeouts: > built-in default (connect 180 s, idle 300 s)
+```
+
+Per-field fallback: an entry overriding only `streamIdleTimeoutMs` leaves the
+connect leg at the lower levels. Configs without the keys behave
+byte-identically (the standing uncapped-run rule). When a scoped override is
+in effect the stall line names it (`idle window 1800s (role default
+override)`), so a wide window never reads as a hang.
+
+Slow-local-model recipe: a local endpoint that thinks minutes before the
+first byte needs the IDLE leg widened, not the whole config. On the role
+chain entry pinning the local endpoint set only `streamIdleTimeoutMs ≈ 2×`
+its worst silent prefill stretch — every cloud provider in the same config
+keeps the global watchdog untouched.
+

+    - provider: openai
+      model: local-thinker
+      baseUrl: http://127.0.0.1:11434/v1
+      streamIdleTimeoutMs: 1800000   # this entry only
+  smol: [openrouter/openai/gpt-4o-mini]   # keeps 300s

# SM kicker — thin stub over the canonical watchdog in the factory home.
# All logic (sm-liveness + head-completeness) lives in
# IstiN/dmtools-agentic-workflows/.github/workflows/factory-sm-kicker.yml;
# defaults below match this repo (ci.yml, three required contexts).
name: SM kicker

run-name: '🥁 kicker ${{ github.event_name }} ${{ github.ref_name }}'

on:
  push:
    branches-ignore: [main]
  schedule:
    - cron: '13,43 * * * *'
  # Event-driven wake-up (2026-10-03, parity with dmtools-dart#338):
  # GitHub starved both crons (machine-sm */10 + kicker 13,43) for 100
  # minutes on dmtools-dart; a green validation verdict sat unlatched the
  # whole window. CI conclusions are the verdict moments — react to them
  # and latching/FIFO-arming happen within seconds, cron or no cron.
  workflow_run:
    workflows: [CI]
    types: [completed]
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  actions: write
  contents: read
  pull-requests: read
  checks: read

jobs:
  kicker:
    # Tracks dmtools-agentic-workflows @main — always-latest policy (owner
    # directive 2026-10-04): kicker fixes (real ticks awf#13, per-head-SHA
    # concurrency awf#14) go live on merge, no re-pin ceremony; the
    # concurrency scoping lives in the reusable workflow. Guarded by
    # test/machine_kit/factory_stub_ref_test.dart.
    #
    # KNOWN UPSTREAM DEFECT (awf#15, live on awf@main as of 2026-10-04):
    # the head-completeness job's `gh api` calls put `--jq` BEFORE
    # `--arg`/`--argjson`, so gh eats the flag as the --jq value and the
    # rest become positional args — `accepts 1 arg(s), received 4`, exit 1.
    # Trigger shape: a CODELESS branch head (2 parents, 0 changed files —
    # a routine branch-sync merge with no content diff). Code-bearing
    # heads skip before the broken lines, so only zero-diff merge heads
    # crash the job — and they crash it even when CI is fully green (the
    # crash precedes the required-contexts check), so the job's own
    # rescue dispatch can never heal the exact heads it exists for.
    # Resolution until the upstream fix lands: keep the branch head
    # CODE-BEARING — the next real commit re-enables the healthy
    # code-bearing-head skip. Diagnosed 2026-10-04 on run 37193754301
    # (head 1fe9b1232, a zero-diff sync merge).
    uses: IstiN/dmtools-agentic-workflows/.github/workflows/factory-sm-kicker.yml@main
    with:
      sm_workflow: machine-sm.yml
      ci_workflow: ci.yml
      ci_display_name: CI
      required_contexts: 'Quality gate,JS engine integration (quickjs-ng),Binaries smoke gate'

# AGENTS.md

Conventions for AI agents and contributors in this repository. Keep it
factual: paths, commands, invariants — no essays.

## Project layout

- `lib/` — the `flutter_agent_harness` package (pure Dart core). `test/`
  mirrors it. `prompts/` — all LLM prompts as Markdown (see rules below).
- `lib/flutter_agent_harness.dart` (the barrel) — gh-1232 policy:
  GROUPED APPEND-ONLY export sections, one `// ── <subsystem> ──` comment
  header per group, exports sorted by path within a group, new exports
  appended to their subsystem group (a new subsystem starts a new group).
  No per-subsystem mini-barrels, no re-sorting of existing lines — append
  only, so parallel edits almost never touch the same line.
- God-file ceiling (gh-1232): no Dart file over 2800 lines anywhere
  (crap4dart `loc` gate, `max_lines: 2800` — issue #1234 migrated the
  shell guards; enforced whole-tree in CI and on staged files by the
  pre-commit hook. Scope: core `lib bin` via `crap4dart.yaml` +
  `test example` via the `crap4dart.loc-scope.yaml` companion config
  (0.11.0 has no per-gate sources override), flutter_app/lib via
  `flutter_app/crap4dart.yaml`).
  Target < 2000 for primary
  files; when a file approaches it, split by concern into `part` files
  (the established pattern: `agent_cli.dart`, `builtin_tools.dart`,
  `bin/fah.dart` → `bin/fah_*.dart`, `agent_service.dart` →
  `agent_service_*.dart` mixins) — never by extracting public API.
- `lib/src/approval/` — tool approval gate: tiers (read/write/exec),
  session modes (always-ask/write/yolo/autopilot — the CLI label of the
  `unattended` enum), per-tool overrides,
  critical-pattern
  `bash` interceptor, per-turn grants (`grantForTurn(allow:, deny:)` —
  skill `allowed-tools`/`disallowed-tools` manifest keys ride these for one
  turn; explicit deny > turnDeny > per-tool override > turnAllow >
  alwaysAllow > mode (critical bash outranks mode in always-ask/write/yolo,
  but is skipped in unattended so the mode never blocks — for runs with no

# Pull Request Information

- **PR #**: 1567
- **URL**: https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/pull/1567
- **Title**: feat(1554): scoped provider timeouts — roles chain entries + customProviders entries override the globals
- **Author**: vabhzw17eg2qu4m9-bit
- **Branch**: `feat/1554-scoped-provider-timeouts` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 17
- **Additions**: +638
- **Deletions**: -74
- **Created**: 2026-10-12T10:58:28Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-12T12:28:15Z

## PR Description

Fixes #1554

Every surface that pins a model endpoint — `roles:` chain entries and `customProviders:` entries (plus the gh-1398 `models.custom` surface) — can carry `connectTimeoutMs`/`streamIdleTimeoutMs`; per FIELD the first level that declares a value wins:

```
role chain entry > customProviders entry > models.custom entry
    > global providerTimeouts: > built-in default (connect 180s, idle 300s)
```

## Delivered (AC checklist)

- [x] **AC1** — roles chain entry timeouts ride the built `Model` (`connectTimeout`/`streamIdleTimeout` + `timeoutScopeLabel` = `role <role> override`) — request-scoped, so they drive the watchdogs for THAT role's streams only, work for catalog-default baseUrls (never URL-seedable before), and two entries on one endpoint keep separate windows. UT: resolver builds labeled models per role, per-field absence stays null. IT (loopback): scoped 1s window fires for its model while a second model in the same session takes the 3s global window; stall line names `idle window 1s (role slow override)`, the unscoped model's does not.
- [x] **AC2** — `customProviders:` entry timeouts scope every resolution through the entry: main provider + roles refs naming its kind+baseUrl resolve through the URL-keyed table (boot seeding, both CLI and app — `bin/fah.dart` IS the CLI boot, `fah_runapp.dart` is its part file).
- [x] **AC3** — the full precedence table per field: `ProviderTuningRegistry.matchesForUrl` returns matching entries in priority order (depth desc, later registration first); `resolveProviderTimeouts` + both wire helpers walk the chain per field, so an entry overriding only the idle leg falls through to the lower surface's connect leg instead of jumping to global. Seed order fixed to `models.custom < customProviders < roleRefs < queue` (the old order inverted customProviders vs models.custom). UTs: mixed-field fall-through, same-field collision, global/default reach, wire-helper agreement, seed-order table.
- [x] **AC4** — backward compat: all new fields nullable; every untouched config resolves byte-identically (empty registry fast paths intact; stall messages unchanged when no scope is in effect; gh-1398 parser suites untouched and still pin valid/absent/malformed/0/negative/over-1h on all four surfaces). The connect stall trace now reports the EFFECTIVE budget (was the raw global default even when a table entry resolved lower — latent gh-1398 inconsistency, fixed in passing).
- [x] **AC5** — docs: new "Scoped provider timeouts" section in `docs/agents/providers.md` (precedence table + slow-local-model recipe) and the `self-settings` skill (`prompts/skills/self-settings/SKILL.md` keys + paragraph; `prompts.g.dart` synced — see gate note).

Design pt 4: stall error lines and `[net]` replay lines keep their shape; a scoped override appends the naming fragment (`— idle window 1800s (role smol override)` / `(<source>)` before the pinned watchdog tags — contains-matching classifiers unaffected).

## Remaining

- Nothing known against the ACs. Non-goals respected: no auto-detection, no escalation-ladder changes, no per-model surface beyond `models:`.

## Verification / local-gate disclosure (honest)

- Targeted local gate attempted once per lane discipline: `dart test` on the three touched test files — **SIGKILLed (exit 137, machine guard), zero output** (the prompts regen script was killed the same way). **Static fallback** used instead: no new Dart files (all edits in existing files, directive order untouched); every referenced symbol verified defined/imported (barrel whole-file exports audited); ast-grep/tree-sitter parse of all 10 changed Dart files reported no parse issues; every changed call site audited (all pre-existing callers positional — additive named params only); 1:1 assertion trace against the implementation caught and fixed 2 wrong assertions in my own new tests before push. `prompts.g.dart` was hand-synced to `scripts/gen_prompts.dart`'s exact escaping (\`dartStringLiteral\`: `'`→`\'`, `$`, `\n`, `\r`, `\t`, non-ASCII raw) — `test/prompts/prompts_sync_test.dart` is the byte-level arbiter in CI.
- The PR's CI is the real gate; no fake test output.

+## Scoped provider timeouts (issue #1554)

+`connectTimeoutMs`/`streamIdleTimeoutMs` (strict positive ints, ≤ 1 h) are

+first level that declares a value wins:

+    > global providerTimeouts: > built-in default (connect 180 s, idle 300 s)
+```

+connect leg at the lower levels. Configs without the keys behave
+byte-identically (the standing uncapped-run rule). When a scoped override is
+in effect the stall line names it (`idle window 1800s (role default
+override)`), so a wide window never reads as a hang.

+first byte needs the IDLE leg widened, not the whole config. On the role
+chain entry pinning the local endpoint set only `streamIdleTimeoutMs ≈ 2×`
+its worst silent prefill stretch — every cloud provider in the same config
+keeps the global watchdog untouched.

+      streamIdleTimeoutMs: 1800000   # this entry only

# SM kicker — thin stub over the canonical watchdog in the factory home.
# All logic (sm-liveness + head-completeness) lives in
# IstiN/dmtools-agentic-workflows/.github/workflows/factory-sm-kicker.yml;
# defaults below match this repo (ci.yml, three required contexts).
name: SM kicker

run-name: '🥁 kicker ${{ github.event_name }} ${{ github.ref_name }}'

on:
  push:
    branches-ignore: [main]
  schedule:
    - cron: '13,43 * * * *'
  # Event-driven wake-up (2026-10-03, parity with dmtools-dart#338):
  # GitHub starved both crons (machine-sm */10 + kicker 13,43) for 100
  # minutes on dmtools-dart; a green validation verdict sat unlatched the
  # whole window. CI conclusions are the verdict moments — react to them
  # and latching/FIFO-arming happen within seconds, cron or no cron.
  workflow_run:
    workflows: [CI]
    types: [completed]
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  actions: write
  contents: read
  pull-requests: read
  checks: read

jobs:
  kicker:
    # Tracks dmtools-agentic-workflows @main — always-latest policy (owner
    # directive 2026-10-04): kicker fixes (real ticks awf#13, per-head-SHA
    # concurrency awf#14) go live on merge, no re-pin ceremony; the
    # concurrency scoping lives in the reusable workflow. Guarded by
    # test/machine_kit/factory_stub_ref_test.dart.
    #
    # KNOWN UPSTREAM DEFECT (awf#15, live on awf@main as of 2026-10-04):
    # the head-completeness job's `gh api` calls put `--jq` BEFORE
    # `--arg`/`--argjson`, so gh eats the flag as the --jq value and the
    # rest become positional args — `accepts 1 arg(s), received 4`, exit 1.
    # Trigger shape: a CODELESS branch head (2 parents, 0 changed files —
    # a routine branch-sync merge with no content diff). Code-bearing
    # heads skip before the broken lines, so only zero-diff merge heads
    # crash the job — and they crash it even when CI is fully green (the
    # crash precedes the required-contexts check), so the job's own
    # rescue dispatch can never heal the exact heads it exists for.
    # Resolution until the upstream fix lands: keep the branch head
    # CODE-BEARING — the next real commit re-enables the healthy
    # code-bearing-head skip. Diagnosed 2026-10-04 on run 37193754301
    # (head 1fe9b1232, a zero-diff sync merge).
    uses: IstiN/dmtools-agentic-workflows/.github/workflows/factory-sm-kicker.yml@main
    with:
      sm_workflow: machine-sm.yml
      ci_workflow: ci.yml
      ci_display_name: CI
      required_contexts: 'Quality gate,JS engine integration (quickjs-ng),Binaries smoke gate'

# AGENTS.md

Conventions for AI agents and contributors in this repository. Keep it
factual: paths, commands, invariants — no essays.

## Project layout

- `lib/` — the `flutter_agent_harness` package (pure Dart core). `test/`
  mirrors it. `prompts/` — all LLM prompts as Markdown (see rules below).
- `lib/flutter_agent_harness.dart` (the barrel) — gh-1232 policy:
  GROUPED APPEND-ONLY export sections, one `// ── <subsystem> ──` comment
  header per group, exports sorted by path within a group, new exports
  appended to their subsystem group (a new subsystem starts a new group).
  No per-subsystem mini-barrels, no re-sorting of existing lines — append
  only, so parallel edits almost never touch the same line.
- God-file ceiling (gh-1232): no Dart file over 2800 lines anywhere
  (crap4dart `loc` gate, `max_lines: 2800` — issue #1234 migrated the
  shell guards; enforced whole-tree in CI and on staged files by the
  pre-commit hook. Scope: core `lib bin` via `crap4dart.yaml` +
  `test example` via the `crap4dart.loc-scope.yaml` companion config
  (0.11.0 has no per-gate sources override), flutter_app/lib via
  `flutter_app/crap4dart.yaml`).
  Target < 2000 for primary
  files; when a file approaches it, split by concern into `part` files
  (the established pattern: `agent_cli.dart`, `builtin_tools.dart`,
  `bin/fah.dart` → `bin/fah_*.dart`, `agent_service.dart` →
  `agent_service_*.dart` mixins) — never by extracting public API.
- `lib/src/approval/` — tool approval gate: tiers (read/write/exec),
  session modes (always-ask/write/yolo/autopilot — the CLI label of the
  `unattended` enum), per-tool overrides,
  critical-pattern
  `bash` interceptor, per-turn grants (`grantForTurn(allow:, deny:)` —
  skill `allowed-tools`/`disallowed-tools` manifest keys ride these for one
  turn; explicit deny > turnDeny > per-tool override > turnAllow >
  alwaysAllow > mode (critical bash outranks mode in always-ask/write/yolo,
  but is skipped in unattended so the mode never blocks — for runs with no
  user present); `clearTurnGrants()`
  on every new user
  message). Wired via `attachApproval` into `beforeToolCall` (runs
  first); prompt UI is an injectable `ApprovalPrompt` (null + prompt policy
  = deny).
- `lib/src/tools/ask_tool.dart` — `ask` tool: structured mid-turn questions
  via injectable `AskCallback` (null = error, cancel = plain result).
- `lib/src/tools/request_secret_tool.dart` — `request_secret` tool: the agent
  asks the USER for a missing credential via injectable
  `RequestSecretCallback` (never in chat text); a grant returns
  `RequestSecretResult` (host-adjusted `name`, `value`, `persisted` flag),
  a decline is a plain result. The app wires it in `AgentService` to
  `secretRequestHandler` (chat screen installs

+`connectTimeoutMs`/`streamIdleTimeoutMs` (strict positive ints, ≤ 1 h) are

+first level that declares a value wins:

+connect leg at the lower levels. Configs without the keys behave
+byte-identically (the standing uncapped-run rule). When a scoped override is

+override)`), so a wide window never reads as a hang.
+
+Slow-local-model recipe: a local endpoint that thinks minutes before the
+first byte needs the IDLE leg widened, not the whole config. On the role
+chain entry pinning the local endpoint set only `streamIdleTimeoutMs ≈ 2×`
+its worst silent prefill stretch — every cloud provider in the same config
+keeps the global watchdog untouched.

name: SM kicker

run-name: '🥁 kicker ${{ github.event_name }} ${{ github.ref_name }}'

on:
  push:
    branches-ignore: [main]
  schedule:
    - cron: '13,43 * * * *'

  # GitHub starved both crons (machine-sm */10 + kicker 13,43) for 100
  # minutes on dmtools-dart; a green validation verdict sat unlatched the
  # whole window. CI conclusions are the verdict moments — react to them
  # and latching/FIFO-arming happen within seconds, cron or no cron.
  workflow_run:
    workflows: [CI]
    types: [completed]
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  actions: write
  contents: read
  pull-requests: read
  checks: read

jobs:

    uses: IstiN/dmtools-agentic-workflows/.github/workflows/factory-sm-kicker.yml@main

# AGENTS.md

Conventions for AI agents and contributors in this repository. Keep it
factual: paths, commands, invariants — no essays.

## Project layout

- `lib/` — the `flutter_agent_harness` package (pure Dart core). `test/`
  mirrors it. `prompts/` — all LLM prompts as Markdown (see rules below).
- `lib/flutter_agent_harness.dart` (the barrel) — gh-1232 policy:
  GROUPED APPEND-ONLY export sections, one `// ── <subsystem> ──` comment
  header per group, exports sorted by path within a group, new exports
  appended to their subsystem group (a new subsystem starts a new group).
  No per-subsystem mini-barrels, no re-sorting of existing lines — append
  only, so parallel edits almost never touch the same line.
- God-file ceiling (gh-1232): no Dart file over 2800 lines anywhere
  (crap4dart `loc` gate, `max_lines: 2800` — issue #1234 migrated the
  shell guards; enforced whole-tree in CI and on staged files by the
  pre-commit hook. Scope: core `lib bin` via `crap4dart.yaml` +
  `test example` via the `crap4dart.loc-scope.yaml` companion config
  (0.11.0 has no per-gate sources override), flutter_app/lib via
  `flutter_app/crap4dart.yaml`).
  Target < 2000 for primary
  files; when a file approaches it, split by concern into `part` files
  (the established pattern: `agent_cli.dart`, `builtin_tools.dart`,
  `bin/fah.dart` → `bin/fah_*.dart`, `agent_service.dart` →
  `agent_service_*.dart` mixins) — never by extracting public API.
- `lib/src/approval/` — tool approval gate: tiers (read/write/exec),
  session modes (always-ask/write/yolo/autopilot — the CLI label of the
  `unattended` enum), per-tool overrides,
  critical-pattern
  `bash` interceptor, per-turn grants (`grantForTurn(allow:, deny:)` —
  skill `allowed-tools`/`disallowed-tools` manifest keys ride these for one
  turn; explicit deny > turnDeny > per-tool override > turnAllow >
  alwaysAllow > mode (critical bash outranks mode in always-ask/write/yolo,
  but is skipped in unattended so the mode never blocks — for runs with no
  user present); `clearTurnGrants()`
  on every new user
  message). Wired via `attachApproval` into `beforeToolCall` (runs
  first); prompt UI is an injectable `ApprovalPrompt` (null + prompt policy
  = deny).
- `lib/src/tools/ask_tool.dart` — `ask` tool: structured mid-turn questions
  via injectable `AskCallback` (null = error, cancel = plain result).
- `lib/src/tools/request_secret_tool.dart` — `request_secret` tool: the agent
  asks the USER for a missing credential via injectable
  `RequestSecretCallback` (never in chat text); a grant returns
  `RequestSecretResult` (host-adjusted `name`, `value`, `persisted` flag),
  a decline is a plain result. The app wires it in `AgentService` to
  `secretRequestHandler` (chat screen installs
  `ui/widgets/secret_request_sheet.dart`): a grant is persisted into
  `SessionKeysStore`, injected into the live shell env via
  `SecretsExecutionEnv.addSecrets` (the map is runtime-mutable now), and
  registered into the same `SecretRedactor` — so the next run's prompt name
  list, bash `$NAME`, and redaction all pick it up.
- `lib/src/env/session_vars_execution_env.dart` — `SessionVarsExecutionEnv`:
  an `ExecutionEnv` decorator injecting session-correlation env vars
  (`FAH_SESSION_ID`/`FAH_SESSION_FILE`/`FAH_PROVIDER`/`FAH_MODEL`, resolved
  live per `exec`, never secrets) into bash tool executions. Wired around
  `builtinTools` in the CLI (`AgentCli`) and the app (`AgentService`).
  `LocalShell` merges `ShellExecOptions.env` OVER `Platform.environment`

Root cause: `provider_tuning.dart` imports `provider_common.dart` through a `show` list that never included `ProviderTimeoutsOverride`. The new scoped-resolution helpers (`field`/`source`, issue #1554) named that type in their closure-parameter signatures — with the name unresolved the parameters collapsed to an invalid type, so every `.connect`/`.streamIdle` member read inside them errored (`Object?` getters) and the nullable global (`providerTimeoutsOverride`, type `ProviderTimeoutsOverride?`) flowed into the non-null typed pick (the `Duration?`→`Duration` pair). The old gh-1398 code never named the type (it leaned on the getter's inferred type), which is why the hole was invisible until this change.

Fix (one commit): add `ProviderTimeoutsOverride` to the show list + `if (global == null) return fallback;` guard before the typed pick. No behavior change.

Both-direction static proof per the PR#1557/#1565 lesson:
- (a) members → real declarations: `ProviderTimeoutsOverride.connect/streamIdle` grepped at provider_common.dart:863/866, getter at :877; `ProviderTuningEntry.connect/streamIdle/name`, `ResolvedProviderTimeouts` fields, `Model.connectTimeout/streamIdleTimeout/timeoutScopeLabel`, `ModelRef.connectTimeout/streamIdleTimeout/label`, `CustomModelDefinition`/`CustomProviderEntry` timeout fields, `createSseIterator(idleTimeout:, timeoutSource:)`, `sendProviderRequest/sendWatchedProviderRequest/_sendWatchedOnce` named params — each checked against its declaration.

# SM kicker — thin stub over the canonical watchdog in the factory home.
# All logic (sm-liveness + head-completeness) lives in
# IstiN/dmtools-agentic-workflows/.github/workflows/factory-sm-kicker.yml;
# defaults below match this repo (ci.yml, three required contexts).
name: SM kicker

run-name: '🥁 kicker ${{ github.event_name }} ${{ github.ref_name }}'

on:
  push:
    branches-ignore: [main]
  schedule:
    - cron: '13,43 * * * *'
  # Event-driven wake-up (2026-10-03, parity with dmtools-dart#338):
  # GitHub starved both crons (machine-sm */10 + kicker 13,43) for 100
  # minutes on dmtools-dart; a green validation verdict sat unlatched the
  # whole window. CI conclusions are the verdict moments — react to them
  # and latching/FIFO-arming happen within seconds, cron or no cron.
  workflow_run:
    workflows: [CI]
    types: [completed]
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  actions: write
  contents: read
  pull-requests: read
  checks: read

jobs:
  kicker:
    # Tracks dmtools-agentic-workflows @main — always-latest policy (owner
    # directive 2026-10-04): kicker fixes (real ticks awf#13, per-head-SHA
    # concurrency awf#14) go live on merge, no re-pin ceremony; the
    # concurrency scoping lives in the reusable workflow. Guarded by
    # test/machine_kit/factory_stub_ref_test.dart.
    #
    # KNOWN UPSTREAM DEFECT (awf#15, live on awf@main as of 2026-10-04):
    # the head-completeness job's `gh api` calls put `--jq` BEFORE
    # `--arg`/`--argjson`, so gh eats the flag as the --jq value and the
    # rest become positional args — `accepts 1 arg(s), received 4`, exit 1.
    # Trigger shape: a CODELESS branch head (2 parents, 0 changed files —
    # a routine branch-sync merge with no content diff). Code-bearing
    # heads skip before the broken lines, so only zero-diff merge heads
    # crash the job — and they crash it even when CI is fully green (the
    # crash precedes the required-contexts check), so the job's own
    # rescue dispatch can never heal the exact heads it exists for.
    # Resolution until the upstream fix lands: keep the branch head
    # CODE-BEARING — the next real commit re-enables the healthy
    # code-bearing-head skip. Diagnosed 2026-10-04 on run 37193754301
    # (head 1fe9b1232, a zero-diff sync merge).
    uses: IstiN/dmtools-agentic-workflows/.github/workflows/factory-sm-kicker.yml@main
    with:
      sm_workflow: machine-sm.yml
      ci_workflow: ci.yml
      ci_display_name: CI
      required_contexts: 'Quality gate,JS engine integration (quickjs-ng),Binaries smoke gate'

However, this specific failure is a transient 502 from a watchdog kicker job that is not a PR gate (it's a scheduled kicker, not a required check on the PR — required contexts are Quality gate, JS engine integration, Binaries smoke gate). The kicker runs on push to any non-main branch + cron; its failure doesn't block merge.

But it's clearly a transient GitHub 502 in an external watchdog job. The pragmatic and honest approach: note it in the general comment as an infra flake that will re-run/needs re-kick, and since no code-level blocking findings exist, verdict...

# AGENTS.md

Conventions for AI agents and contributors in this repository. Keep it
factual: paths, commands, invariants — no essays.

## Project layout

- `lib/` — the `flutter_agent_harness` package (pure Dart core). `test/`
  mirrors it. `prompts/` — all LLM prompts as Markdown (see rules below).
- `lib/flutter_agent_harness.dart` (the barrel) — gh-1232 policy:
  GROUPED APPEND-ONLY export sections, one `// ── <subsystem> ──` comment
  header per group, exports sorted by path within a group, new exports
  appended to their subsystem group (a new subsystem starts a new group).
  No per-subsystem mini-barrels, no re-sorting of existing lines — append
  only, so parallel edits almost never touch the same line.
- God-file ceiling (gh-1232): no Dart file over 2800 lines anywhere
  (crap4dart `loc` gate, `max_lines: 2800` — issue #1234 migrated the
  shell guards; enforced whole-tree in CI and on staged files by the
  pre-commit hook. Scope: core `lib bin` via `crap4dart.yaml` +
  `test example` via the `crap4dart.loc-scope.yaml` companion config
  (0.11.0 has no per-gate sources override), flutter_app/lib via
  `flutter_app/crap4dart.yaml`).
  Target < 2000 for primary
  files; when a file approaches it, split by concern into `part` files
  (the established pattern: `agent_cli.dart`, `builtin_tools.dart`,
  `bin/fah.dart` → `bin/fah_*.dart`, `agent_service.dart` →
  `agent_service_*.dart` mixins) — never by extracting public API.
- `lib/src/approval/` — tool approval gate: tiers (read/write/exec),
  session modes (always-ask/write/yolo/autopilot — the CLI label of the
  `unattended` enum), per-tool overrides,
  critical-pattern
  `bash` interceptor, per-turn grants (`grantForTurn(allow:, deny:)` —
  skill `allowed-tools`/`disallowed-tools` manifest keys ride these for one
  turn; explicit deny > turnDeny > per-tool override > turnAllow >
  alwaysAllow > mode (critical bash outranks mode in always-ask/write/yolo,
  but is skipped in unattended so the mode never blocks — for runs with no
  user present); `clearTurnGrants()`
  on every new user
  message). Wired via `attachApproval` into `beforeToolCall` (runs
  first); prompt UI is an injectable `ApprovalPrompt` (null + prompt policy
  = deny).
- `lib/src/tools/ask_tool.dart` — `ask` tool: structured mid-turn questions
  via injectable `AskCallback` (null = error, cancel = plain result).
- `lib/src/tools/request_secret_tool.dart` — `request_secret` tool: the agent
  asks the USER for a missing credential via injectable
  `RequestSecretCallback` (never in chat text); a grant returns
  `RequestSecretResult` (host-adjusted `name`, `value`, `persisted` flag),
  a decline is a plain result. The app wires it in `AgentService` to
  `secretRequestHandler` (chat screen installs
  `ui/widgets/secret_request_sheet.dart`): a grant is persisted into
  `SessionKeysStore`, injected into the live shell env via
  `SecretsExecutionEnv.addSecrets` (the map is runtime-mutable now), and
  registered into the same `SecretRedactor` — so the next run's prompt name
  list, bash `$NAME`, and redaction all pick it up.
- `lib/src/env/session_vars_execution_env.dart` — `SessionVarsExecutionEnv`:
  an `ExecutionEnv` decorator injecting session-correlation env vars
  (`FAH_SESSION_ID`/`FAH_SESSION_FILE`/`FAH_PROVIDER`/`FAH_MODEL`, resolved
  live per `exec`, never secrets) into bash tool executions. Wired around
  `builtinTools` in the CLI (`AgentCli`) and the app (`AgentService`).
  `LocalShell` merges `ShellExecOptions.env` OVER `Platform.environment`

+## Scoped provider timeouts (issue #1554)
+
+`connectTimeoutMs`/`streamIdleTimeoutMs` (strict positive ints, ≤ 1 h) are

+`customProviders:` entries, and `models.custom:` entries. Per FIELD, the
+first level that declares a value wins:

+```
+role chain entry > customProviders entry > models.custom entry
+    > global providerTimeouts: > built-in default (connect 180 s, idle 300 s)
+```
+

+connect leg at the lower levels. Configs without the keys behave
+byte-identically (the standing uncapped-run rule). When a scoped override is
+in effect the stall line names it (`idle window 1800s (role default
+override)`), so a wide window never reads as a hang.
+
+Slow-local-model recipe: a local endpoint that thinks minutes before the
+first byte needs the IDLE leg widened, not the whole config. On the role
+chain entry pinning the local endpoint set only `streamIdleTimeoutMs ≈ 2×`
+its worst silent prefill stretch — every cloud provider in the same config
+keeps the global watchdog untouched.

+      streamIdleTimeoutMs: 1800000   # this entry only

{
  "key": "pr-1567",
  "fields": {
    "summary": "feat(1554): scoped provider timeouts — roles chain entries + customProviders entries override the globals",
    "description": "Fixes #1554

Every surface that pins a model endpoint — `roles:` chain entries and `customProviders:` entries (plus the gh-1398 `models.custom` surface) — can carry `connectTimeoutMs`/`streamIdleTimeoutMs`; per FIELD the first level that declares a value wins:

```
role chain entry > customProviders entry > models.custom entry
    > global providerTimeouts: > built-in default (connect 180s, idle 300s)
```

## Delivered (AC checklist)

- [x] **AC1** — roles chain entry timeouts ride the built `Model` (`connectTimeout`/`streamIdleTimeout` + `timeoutScopeLabel` = `role <role> override`) — request-scoped, so they drive the watchdogs for THAT role's streams only, work for catalog-default baseUrls (never URL-seedable before), and two entries on one endpoint keep separate windows. UT: resolver builds labeled models per role, per-field absence stays null. IT (loopback): scoped 1s window fires for its model while a second model in the same session takes the 3s global window; stall line names `idle window 1s (role slow override)`, the unscoped model's does not.
- [x] **AC2** — `customProviders:` entry timeouts scope every resolution through the entry: main provider + roles refs naming its kind+baseUrl resolve through the URL-keyed table (boot seeding, both CLI and app — `bin/fah.dart` IS the CLI boot, `fah_runapp.dart` is its part file).
- [x] **AC3** — the full precedence table per field: `ProviderTuningRegistry.matchesForUrl` returns matching entries in priority order (depth desc, later registration first); `resolveProviderTimeouts` + both wire helpers walk the chain per field, so an entry overriding only the idle leg falls through to the lower surface's connect leg instead of jumping to global. Seed order fixed to `models.custom < customProviders < roleRefs < queue` (the old order inverted customProviders vs models.custom). UTs: mixed-field fall-through, same-field collision, global/default reach, wire-helper agreement, seed-order table.
- [x] **AC4** — backward compat: all new fields nullable; every untouched config resolves byte-identically (empty registry fast paths intact; stall messages unchanged when no scope is in effect; gh-1398 parser suites untouched and still pin valid/absent/malformed/0/negative/over-1h on all four surfaces). The connect stall trace now reports the EFFECTIVE budget (was the raw global default even when a table entry resolved lower — latent gh-1398 inconsistency, fixed in passing).
- [x] **AC5** — docs: new "Scoped provider timeouts" section in `docs/agents/providers.md` (precedence table + slow-local-model recipe) and the `self-settings` skill (`prompts/skills/self-settings/SKILL.md` keys + paragraph; `prompts.g.dart` synced — see gate note).

Design pt 4: stall error lines and `[net]` replay lines keep their shape; a scoped override appends the naming fragment (`— idle window 1800s (role smol override)` / `(<source>)` before the pinned watchdog tags — contains-matching classifiers unaffected).

## Remaining

- Nothing known against the ACs. Non-goals respected: no auto-detection, no escalation-ladder changes, no per-model surface beyond `models:`.

# SM kicker — thin stub over the canonical watchdog in the factory home.
# All logic (sm-liveness + head-completeness) lives in
# IstiN/dmtools-agentic-workflows/.github/workflows/factory-sm-kicker.yml;
# defaults below match this repo (ci.yml, three required contexts).
name: SM kicker

run-name: '🥁 kicker ${{ github.event_name }} ${{ github.ref_name }}'

on:
  push:
    branches-ignore: [main]
  schedule:
    - cron: '13,43 * * * *'
  # Event-driven wake-up (2026-10-03, parity with dmtools-dart#338):
  # GitHub starved both crons (machine-sm */10 + kicker 13,43) for 100
  # minutes on dmtools-dart; a green validation verdict sat unlatched the
  # whole window. CI conclusions are the verdict moments — react to them
  # and latching/FIFO-arming happen within seconds, cron or no cron.
  workflow_run:
    workflows: [CI]
    types: [completed]
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  actions: write
  contents: read
  pull-requests: read
  checks: read

jobs:
  kicker:
    # Tracks dmtools-agentic-workflows @main — always-latest policy (owner
    # directive 2026-10-04): kicker fixes (real ticks awf#13, per-head-SHA
    # concurrency awf#14) go live on merge, no re-pin ceremony; the
    # concurrency scoping lives in the reusable workflow. Guarded by
    # test/machine_kit/factory_stub_ref_test.dart.
    #
    # KNOWN UPSTREAM DEFECT (awf#15, live on awf@main as of 2026-10-04):
    # the head-completeness job's `gh api` calls put `--jq` BEFORE
    # `--arg`/`--argjson`, so gh eats the flag as the --jq value and the
    # rest become positional args — `accepts 1 arg(s), received 4`, exit 1.
    # Trigger shape: a CODELESS branch head (2 parents, 0 changed files —
    # a routine branch-sync merge with no content diff). Code-bearing
    # heads skip before the broken lines, so only zero-diff merge heads
    # crash the job — and they crash it even when CI is fully green (the
    # crash precedes the required-contexts check), so the job's own
    # rescue dispatch can never heal the exact heads it exists for.
    # Resolution until the upstream fix lands: keep the branch head
    # CODE-BEARING — the next real commit re-enables the healthy
    # code-bearing-head skip. Diagnosed 2026-10-04 on run 37193754301
    # (head 1fe9b1232, a zero-diff sync merge).
    uses: IstiN/dmtools-agentic-workflows/.github/workflows/factory-sm-kicker.yml@main
    with:
      sm_workflow: machine-sm.yml
      ci_workflow: ci.yml
      ci_display_name: CI
      required_contexts: 'Quality gate,JS engine integration (quickjs-ng),Binaries smoke gate'

The failing check is `kicker / sm-liveness` from the sm-kicker workflow — which is a watchdog/kicker job, not a test of the PR code. The known upstream defect awf#15 mentions crashes on zero-diff merge heads. The sm-liveness job is part of the factory watchdog. Without ci_failures_full.log, I can't see the exact error. # AGENTS.md

Conventions for AI agents and contributors in this repository. Keep it
factual: paths, commands, invariants — no essays.

## Project layout

- `lib/` — the `flutter_agent_harness` package (pure Dart core). `test/`
  mirrors it. `prompts/` — all LLM prompts as Markdown (see rules below).
- `lib/flutter_agent_harness.dart` (the barrel) — gh-1232 policy:
  GROUPED APPEND-ONLY export sections, one `// ── <subsystem> ──` comment
  header per group, exports sorted by path within a group, new exports
  appended to their subsystem group (a new subsystem starts a new group).
  No per-subsystem mini-barrels, no re-sorting of existing lines — append

# SM kicker — thin stub over the canonical watchdog in the factory home.
# All logic (sm-liveness + head-completeness) lives in
# IstiN/dmtools-agentic-workflows/.github/workflows/factory-sm-kicker.yml;
# defaults below match this repo (ci.yml, three required contexts).
name: SM kicker

run-name: '🥁 kicker ${{ github.event_name }} ${{ github.ref_name }}'

on:
  push:
    branches-ignore: [main]
  schedule:
    - cron: '13,43 * * * *'
  # Event-driven wake-up (2026-10-03, parity with dmtools-dart#338):
  # GitHub starved both crons (machine-sm */10 + kicker 13,43) for 100
  # minutes on dmtools-dart; a green validation verdict sat unlatched the
  # whole window. CI conclusions are the verdict moments — react to them
  # and latching/FIFO-arming happen within seconds, cron or no cron.
  workflow_run:
    workflows: [CI]
    types: [completed]
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  actions: write
  contents: read
  pull-requests: read
  checks: read

jobs:
  kicker:
    # Tracks dmtools-agentic-workflows @main — always-latest policy (owner
    # directive 2026-10-04): kicker fixes (real ticks awf#13, per-head-SHA
    # concurrency awf#14) go live on merge, no re-pin ceremony; the
    # concurrency scoping lives in the reusable workflow. Guarded by
    # test/machine_kit/factory_stub_ref_test.dart.
    #
    # KNOWN UPSTREAM DEFECT (awf#15, live on awf@main as of 2026-10-04):
    # the head-completeness job's `gh api` calls put `--jq` BEFORE
    # `--arg`/`--argjson`, so gh eats the flag as the --jq value and the
    # rest become positional args — `accepts 1 arg(s), received 4`, exit 1.

# AGENTS.md

Conventions for AI agents and contributors in this repository. Keep it
factual: paths, commands, invariants — no essays.

## Project layout

- `lib/` — the `flutter_agent_harness` package (pure Dart core). `test/`
  mirrors it. `prompts/` — all LLM prompts as Markdown (see rules below).
- `lib/flutter_agent_harness.dart` (the barrel) — gh-1232 policy:
  GROUPED APPEND-ONLY export sections, one `// ── <subsystem> ──` comment
  header per group, exports sorted by path within a group, new exports
  appended to their subsystem group (a new subsystem starts a new group).
  No per-subsystem mini-barrels, no re-sorting of existing lines — append
  only, so parallel edits almost never touch the same line.
- God-file ceiling (gh-1232): no Dart file over 2800 lines anywhere
  (crap4dart `loc` gate, `max_lines: 2800` — issue #1234 migrated the
  shell guards; enforced whole-tree in CI and on staged files by the
  pre-commit hook. Scope: core `lib bin` via `crap4dart.yaml` +
  `test example` via the `crap4dart.loc-scope.yaml` companion config
  (0.11.0 has no per-gate sources override), flutter_app/lib via
  `flutter_app/crap4dart.yaml`).
  Target < 2000 for primary
  files; when a file approaches it, split by concern into `part` files
  (the established pattern: `agent_cli.dart`, `builtin_tools.dart`,
  `bin/fah.dart` → `bin/fah_*.dart`, `agent_service.dart` →
  `agent_service_*.dart` mixins) — never by extracting public API.
- `lib/src/approval/` — tool approval gate: tiers (read/write/exec),
  session modes (always-ask/write/yolo/autopilot — the CLI label of the
  `unattended` enum), per-tool overrides,
  critical-pattern
  `bash` interceptor, per-turn grants (`grantForTurn(allow:, deny:)` —
  skill `allowed-tools`/`disallowed-tools` manifest keys ride these for one
  turn; explicit deny > turnDeny > per-tool override > turnAllow >
  alwaysAllow > mode (critical bash outranks mode in always-ask/write/yolo,
  but is skipped in unattended so the mode never blocks — for runs with no
  user present); `clearTurnGrants()`
  on every new user
  message). Wired via `attachApproval` into `beforeToolCall` (runs
  first); prompt UI is an injectable `ApprovalPrompt` (null + prompt policy
  = deny).
- `lib/src/tools/ask_tool.dart` — `ask` tool: structured mid-turn questions
  via injectable `AskCallback` (null = error, cancel = plain result).
- `lib/src/tools/request_secret_tool.dart` — `request_secret` tool: the agent
  asks the USER for a missing credential via injectable
  `RequestSecretCallback` (never in chat text); a grant returns
  `RequestSecretResult` (host-adjusted `name`, `value`, `persisted` flag),
  a decline is a plain result. The app wires it in `AgentService` to
  `secretRequestHandler` (chat screen installs
  `ui/widgets/secret_request_sheet.dart`): a grant is persisted into
  `SessionKeysStore`, injected into the live shell env via
  `SecretsExecutionEnv.addSecrets` (the map is runtime-mutable now), and
  registered into the same `SecretRedactor` — so the next run's prompt name
  list, bash `$NAME`, and redaction all pick it up.
- `lib/src/env/session_vars_execution_env.dart` — `SessionVarsExecutionEnv`:
  an `ExecutionEnv` decorator injecting session-correlation env vars
  (`FAH_SESSION_ID`/`FAH_SESSION_FILE`/`FAH_PROVIDER`/`FAH_MODEL`, resolved
  live per `exec`, never secrets) into bash tool executions. Wired around
  `builtinTools` in the CLI (`AgentCli`) and the app (`AgentService`).
  `LocalShell` merges `ShellExecOptions.env` OVER `Platform.environment`

# SM kicker — thin stub over the canonical watchdog in the factory home.
# All logic (sm-liveness + head-completeness) lives in
# IstiN/dmtools-agentic-workflows/.github/workflows/factory-sm-kicker.yml;
# defaults below match this repo (ci.yml, three required contexts).
name: SM kicker

run-name: '🥁 kicker ${{ github.event_name }} ${{ github.ref_name }}'

on:
  push:
    branches-ignore: [main]
  schedule:
    - cron: '13,43 * * * *'
  # Event-driven wake-up (2026-10-03, parity with dmtools-dart#338):
  # GitHub starved both crons (machine-sm */10 + kicker 13,43) for 100
  # minutes on dmtools-dart; a green validation verdict sat unlatched the
  # whole window. CI conclusions are the verdict moments — react to them
  # and latching/FIFO-arming happen within seconds, cron or no cron.
  workflow_run:
    workflows: [CI]
    types: [completed]
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  actions: write
  contents: read
  pull-requests: read
  checks: read

jobs:
  kicker:
    # Tracks dmtools-agentic-workflows @main — always-latest policy (owner
    # directive 2026-10-04): kicker fixes (real ticks awf#13, per-head-SHA
    # concurrency awf#14) go live on merge, no re-pin ceremony; the
    # concurrency scoping lives in the reusable workflow. Guarded by
    # test/machine_kit/factory_stub_ref_test.dart.
    #
    # KNOWN UPSTREAM DEFECT (awf#15, live on awf@main as of 2026-10-04):
    # the head-completeness job's `gh api` calls put `--jq` BEFORE
    # `--arg`/`--argjson`, so gh eats the flag as the --jq value and the
    # rest become positional args — `accepts 1 arg(s), received 4`, exit 1.
    # Trigger shape: a CODELESS branch head (2 parents, 0 changed files —
    # a routine branch-sync merge with no content diff). Code-bearing
    # heads skip before the broken lines, so only zero-diff merge heads
    # crash the job — and they crash it even when CI is fully green (the
    # crash precedes the required-contexts check), so the job's own
    # rescue dispatch can never heal the exact heads it exists for.
    # Resolution until the upstream fix lands: keep the branch head
    # CODE-BEARING — the next real commit re-enables the healthy
    # code-bearing-head skip. Diagnosed 2026-10-04 on run 37193754301
    # (head 1fe9b1232, a zero-diff sync merge).
    uses: IstiN/dmtools-agentic-workflows/.github/workflows/factory-sm-kicker.yml@main
    with:
      sm_workflow: machine-sm.yml
      ci_workflow: ci.yml
      ci_display_name: CI
      required_contexts: 'Quality gate,JS engine integration (quickjs-ng),Binaries smoke gate'

# AGENTS.md

Conventions for AI agents and contributors in this repository. Keep it
factual: paths, commands, invariants — no essays.

## Project layout

- `lib/` — the `flutter_agent_harness` package (pure Dart core). `test/`
  mirrors it. `prompts/` — all LLM prompts as Markdown (see rules below).
- `lib/flutter_agent_harness.dart` (the barrel) — gh-1232 policy:
  GROUPED APPEND-ONLY export sections, one `// ── <subsystem> ──` comment
  header per group, exports sorted by path within a group, new exports
  appended to their subsystem group (a new subsystem starts a new group).
  No per-subsystem mini-barrels, no re-sorting of existing lines — append
  only, so parallel edits almost never touch the same line.
- God-file ceiling (gh-1232): no Dart file over 2800 lines anywhere
  (crap4dart `loc` gate, `max_lines: 2800` — issue #1234 migrated the
  shell guards; enforced whole-tree in CI and on staged files by the
  pre-commit hook. Scope: core `lib bin` via `crap4dart.yaml` +
  `test example` via the `crap4dart.loc-scope.yaml` companion config
  (0.11.0 has no per-gate sources override), flutter_app/lib via
  `flutter_app/crap4dart.yaml`).
  Target < 2000 for primary
  files; when a file approaches it, split by concern into `part` files
  (the established pattern: `agent_cli.dart`, `builtin_tools.dart`,
  `bin/fah.dart` → `bin/fah_*.dart`, `agent_service.dart` →
  `agent_service_*.dart` mixins) — never by extracting public API.
- `lib/src/approval/` — tool approval gate: tiers (read/write/exec),

# SM kicker — thin stub over the canonical watchdog in the factory home.
# All logic (sm-liveness + head-completeness) lives in
# IstiN/dmtools-agentic-workflows/.github/workflows/factory-sm-kicker.yml;
# defaults below match this repo (ci.yml, three required contexts).
name: SM kicker

run-name: '🥁 kicker ${{ github.event_name }} ${{ github.ref_name }}'

on:
  push:
    branches-ignore: [main]
  schedule:
    - cron: '13,43 * * * *'
  # Event-driven wake-up (2026-10-03, parity with dmtools-dart#338):
  # GitHub starved both crons (machine-sm */10 + kicker 13,43) for 100
  # minutes on dmtools-dart; a green validation verdict sat unlatched the
  # whole window. CI conclusions are the verdict moments — react to them
  # and latching/FIFO-arming happen within seconds, cron or no cron.
  workflow_run:
    workflows: [CI]
    types: [completed]
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  actions: write
  contents: read
  pull-requests: read
  checks: read

jobs:
  kicker:
    # Tracks dmtools-agentic-workflows @main — always-latest policy (owner
    # directive 2026-10-04): kicker fixes (real ticks awf#13, per-head-SHA
    # concurrency awf#14) go live on merge, no re-pin ceremony; the
    # concurrency scoping lives in the reusable workflow. Guarded by
    # test/machine_kit/factory_stub_ref_test.dart.
    #
    # KNOWN UPSTREAM DEFECT (awf#15, live on awf@main as of 2026-10-04):
    # the head-completeness job's `gh api` calls put `--jq` BEFORE
    # `--arg`/`--argjson`, so gh eats the flag as the --jq value and the
    # rest become positional args — `accepts 1 arg(s), received 4`, exit 1.
    # Trigger shape: a CODELESS branch head (2 parents, 0 changed files —
    # a routine branch-sync merge with no content diff). Code-bearing
    # heads skip before the broken lines, so only zero-diff merge heads
    # crash the job — and they crash it even when CI is fully green (the
    # crash precedes the required-contexts check), so the job's own
    # rescue dispatch can never heal the exact heads it exists for.
    # Resolution until the upstream fix lands: keep the branch head
    # CODE-BEARING — the next real commit re-enables the healthy
    # code-bearing-head skip. Diagnosed 2026-10-04 on run 37193754301
    # (head 1fe9b1232, a zero-diff sync merge).
    uses: IstiN/dmtools-agentic-workflows/.github/workflows/factory-sm-kicker.yml@main
    with:
      sm_workflow: machine-sm.yml
      ci_workflow: ci.yml
      ci_display_name: CI
      required_contexts: 'Quality gate,JS engine integration (quickjs-ng),Binaries smoke gate'

# AGENTS.md

Conventions for AI agents and contributors in this repository. Keep it
factual: paths, commands, invariants — no essays.

## Project layout

- `lib/` — the `flutter_agent_harness` package (pure Dart core). `test/`
  mirrors it. `prompts/` — all LLM prompts as Markdown (see rules below).
- `lib/flutter_agent_harness.dart` (the barrel) — gh-1232 policy:
  GROUPED APPEND-ONLY export sections, one `// ── <subsystem> ──` comment
  header per group, exports sorted by path within a group, new exports
  appended to their subsystem group (a new subsystem starts a new group).
  No per-subsystem mini-barrels, no re-sorting of existing lines — append
  only, so parallel edits almost never touch the same line.
- God-file ceiling (gh-1232): no Dart file over 2800 lines anywhere
  (crap4dart `loc` gate, `max_lines: 2800` — issue #1234 migrated the
  shell guards; enforced whole-tree in CI and on staged files by the
  pre-commit hook. Scope: core `lib bin` via `crap4dart.yaml` +
  `test example` via the `crap4dart.loc-scope.yaml` companion config
  (0.11.0 has no per-gate sources override), flutter_app/lib via
  `flutter_app/crap4dart.yaml`).
  Target < 2000 for primary
  files; when a file approaches it, split by concern into `part` files
  (the established pattern: `agent_cli.dart`, `builtin_tools.dart`,
  `bin/fah.dart` → `bin/fah_*.dart`, `agent_service.dart` →
  `agent_service_*.dart` mixins) — never by extracting public API.
- `lib/src/approval/` — tool approval gate: tiers (read/write/exec),
  session modes (always-ask/write/yolo/autopilot — the CLI label of the
  `unattended` enum), per-tool overrides,
  critical-pattern
  `bash` interceptor, per-turn grants (`grantForTurn(allow:, deny:)` —
  skill `allowed-tools`/`disallowed-tools` manifest keys ride these for one
  turn; explicit deny > turnDeny > per-tool override > turnAllow >
  alwaysAllow > mode (critical bash outranks mode in always-ask/write/yolo,
  but is skipped in unattended so the mode never blocks — for runs with no
  user present); `clearTurnGrants()`
  on every new user
  message). Wired via `attachApproval` into `beforeToolCall` (runs
  first); prompt UI is an injectable `ApprovalPrompt` (null + prompt policy
  = deny).
- `lib/src/tools/ask_tool.dart` — `ask` tool: structured mid-turn questions
  via injectable `AskCallback` (null = error, cancel = plain result).
- `lib/src/tools/request_secret_tool.dart` — `request_secret` tool: the agent
  asks the USER for a missing credential via injectable
  `RequestSecretCallback` (never in chat text); a grant returns
  `RequestSecretResult` (host-adjusted `name`, `value`, `persisted` flag),
  a decline is a plain result. The app wires it in `AgentService` to
  `secretRequestHandler` (chat screen installs
  `ui/widgets/secret_request_sheet.dart`): a grant is persisted into
  `SessionKeysStore`, injected into the live shell env via
  `SecretsExecutionEnv.addSecrets` (the map is runtime-mutable now), and
  registered into the same `SecretRedactor` — so the next run's prompt name
  list, bash `$NAME`, and redaction all pick it up.
- `lib/src/env/session_vars_execution_env.dart` — `SessionVarsExecutionEnv`:
  an `ExecutionEnv` decorator injecting session-correlation env vars
  (`FAH_SESSION_ID`/`FAH_SESSION_FILE`/`FAH_PROVIDER`/`FAH_MODEL`, resolved
  live per `exec`, never secrets) into bash tool executions. Wired around
  `builtinTools` in the CLI (`AgentCli`) and the app (`AgentService`).
  `LocalShell` merges `ShellExecOptions.env` OVER `Platform.environment`

role chain entry > customProviders entry > models.custom entry

```

- [x] **AC1** — roles chain entry timeouts ride the built `Model` (`connectTimeout`/`streamIdleTimeout` + `timeoutScopeLabel` = `role <role> override`) — request-scoped, so they drive the watchdogs for THAT role's streams only, work for catalog-default baseUrls (never URL-seedable before), and two entries on one endpoint keep separate windows. IT (loopback): scoped 1s window fires for its model while a second model in the same session takes the 3s global window; stall line names `idle window 1s (role slow override)`, the unscoped model's does not.
- [x] **AC2** — `customProviders:` entry timeouts scope every resolution through the entry: main provider + roles refs naming its kind+baseUrl resolve through the URL-keyed table (boot seeding, both CLI and app — `bin/fah.dart` IS the CLI boot, `fah_runapp.dart` is its part file).

# SM kicker — thin stub over the canonical watchdog in the factory home.
# All logic (sm-liveness + head-completeness) lives in
# IstiN/dmtools-agentic-workflows/.github/workflows/factory-sm-kicker.yml;
# defaults below match this repo (ci.yml, three required contexts).
name: SM kicker

run-name: '🥁 kicker ${{ github.event_name }} ${{ github.ref_name }}'

on:
  push:
    branches-ignore: [main]
  schedule:
    - cron: '13,43 * * * *'
  # Event-driven wake-up (2026-10-03, parity with dmtools-dart#338):
  # GitHub starved both crons (machine-sm */10 + kicker 13,43) for 100
  # minutes on dmtools-dart; a green validation verdict sat unlatched the
  # whole window. CI conclusions are the verdict moments — react to them
  # and latching/FIFO-arming happen within seconds, cron or no cron.
  workflow_run:
    workflows: [CI]
    types: [completed]
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  actions: write
  contents: read
  pull-requests: read
  checks: read

jobs:
  kicker:
    # Tracks dmtools-agentic-workflows @main — always-latest policy (owner
    # directive 2026-10-04): kicker fixes (real ticks awf#13, per-head-SHA
    # concurrency awf#14) go live on merge, no re-pin ceremony; the
    # concurrency scoping lives in the reusable workflow. Guarded by
    # test/machine_kit/factory_stub_ref_test.dart.
    #
    # KNOWN UPSTREAM DEFECT (awf#15, live on awf@main as of 2026-10-04):
    # the head-completeness job's `gh api` calls put `--jq` BEFORE
    # `--arg`/`--argjson`, so gh eats the flag as the --jq value and the
    # rest become positional args — `accepts 1 arg(s), received 4`, exit 1.
    # Trigger shape: a CODELESS branch head (2 parents, 0 changed files —
    # a routine branch-sync merge with no content diff). Code-bearing
    # heads skip before the broken lines, so only zero-diff merge heads
    # crash the job — and they crash it even when CI is fully green (the
    # crash precedes the required-contexts check), so the job's own
    # rescue dispatch can never heal the exact heads it exists for.
    # Resolution until the upstream fix lands: keep the branch head
    # CODE-BEARING — the next real commit re-enables the healthy
    # code-bearing-head skip. Diagnosed 2026-10-04 on run 37193754301
    # (head 1fe9b1232, a zero-diff sync merge).
    uses: IstiN/dmtools-agentic-workflows/.github/workflows/factory-sm-kicker.yml@main
    with:
      sm_workflow: machine-sm.yml
      ci_workflow: ci.yml
      ci_display_name: CI
      required_contexts: 'Quality gate,JS engine integration (quickjs-ng),Binaries smoke gate'

The failing check is `kicker / sm-liveness` from the sm-kicker workflow — which is a watchdog/kicker job, not a test of the PR code. blocks.text:
Note: `timeoutSource` is passed to the iterator regardless of whether `idleTimeout` was the explicit param or table-resolved. The adapters pass `timeoutSource: model.timeoutScopeLabel` — which is non-null only when the model carries scoped timeouts. But subtle bug: in `_IdleWatchdogSseIterator`, the stall message uses `_idleTimeout.inSeconds` and the scoped note claims that window belongs to the scope. If a model has `connectTimeout` set but NOT `streamIdleTimeout` (per-field), then `timeoutScopeLabel` is still non-null ('role x override' — set when either field non-null), and the idle stall line would render `idle window 300s (role x override)` even though the idle window is the resolved table/global one, not the role's override! The role entry only overrode connect; the idle leg fell through to lower surfaces, but the stall message attributes the idle window to the role override. That's a misleading label — a real correctness/UX issue.

Check model_resolver: `timeoutScopeLabel: ref.connectTimeout == null && ref.streamIdleTimeout == null ? null : 'role $role override'`. So if only connectTimeout set, label = 'role x override'. Then in anthropic.dart etc., `createSseIterator(..., idleTimeout: model.streamIdleTimeout /* null */, timeoutSource: model.timeoutScopeLabel /* non-null */)`. Inside: effectiveIdleTimeout = null ?? table lookup → resolved value. Stall line: `no events from the endpoint for 300s (stream idle timeout — idle window 300s (role x override))`. The idle window is NOT the role's override — it's the table/global value. Misattribution.

Same in startProviderRequest/connect path: connectTimeout = model.connectTimeout non-null → fine; but if only streamIdle set: connect path gets connectTimeout: null, timeoutSource: 'role x override' → connect stall line reads `no response headers within 180s (role x override)` — but the connect window wasn't overridden by the role! Misattribution again.

This is a real finding: per-field labeling. The label should be per-leg: e.g. pass a connect-specific label and idle-specific label, or only apply the scoped note when that leg's value actually came from the model. Severity: IMPORTANT (diagnostic misattribution — could mislead debugging; not a functional break of the watchdog itself).

Let me double-check the message shapes:

Connect stall: `'provider stream request to ${url} timed out: no response headers within ${effectiveConnect.inSeconds}s$scopedNote ...'` where scopedNote = ' ($timeoutSource)'. With only-idle override: connect leg fell to table/global, message says "(role x override)". Misleading. Yes.

Idle stall in provider_common: `'no events from the endpoint for ${_idleTimeout.inSeconds}s (stream idle timeout$scopedNote)'` with scopedNote = ' — idle window ${...}s ($timeoutSource)'. With only-connect override: misattributes the idle window.

Same issue in chatgpt_codex.dart `_consumeSseLines`: `idle = model.streamIdleTimeout ?? effective...`; scopedNote when model.timeoutScopeLabel != null — same misattribution when only connect overridden.

Also openai_completions handles it correctly-ish: `timeoutSource: options?.idleTimeout == null ? model.timeoutScopeLabel : null` — but should also check `model.streamIdleTimeout != null`! If options?.idleTimeout == null and model.streamIdleTimeout == null but model.connectTimeout != null (label non-null), then scopedIdle = null → createSseIterator resolves via table, but timeoutSource = label non-null → stall line misattributes. So all four adapters have the flaw; openai_completions partially guards (options case) but not the connect-only case.

The clean fix: split labels per leg (e.g. `connectTimeoutScopeLabel`/`streamIdleTimeoutScopeLabel` on Model) or only pass timeoutSource when the corresponding leg value is non-null.

Second potential issue: AC4 claim "every untouched config resolves byte-identically" — the seed-order change (customModels now before customProviders) changes resolution for configs that set BOTH models.custom and customProviders timeouts on the same baseUrl. Old: customProviders registered first, then customModels → at equal depth, later wins → models.custom won. New: customProviders wins. This is an intended precedence change (part of the feature), but it contradicts "byte-identical for untouched configs" in that specific combination. So a config with both surfaces declaring timeouts on the same endpoint would now resolve differently. The PR acknowledges "the old order inverted customProviders vs models.custom" — deliberate fix.
